title: List of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location"

entities.name: List of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location
entities.description: A stored list in the UE containing PLMNs that are not permitted to operate at the current UE location when using satellite NG-RAN access. Each entry includes PLMN identity, geographical location (if known), and a UE implementation specific distance value.

entities.name: PLMN identity
entities.description: The identity of the PLMN that sent a message with 5GMM cause value #78 via satellite NG-RAN access.

entities.name: Geographical location
entities.description: The location where 5GMM cause value #78 was received, stored if known by the UE.

entities.name: UE implementation specific distance value
entities.description: A UE-specific distance threshold used to determine if the UE is far enough from the stored location to attempt access.

entities.name: Timer instance for PLMN entry
entities.description: A timer started when a new entry is stored in the list. Duration is implementation-specific but not smaller than the Lower bound timer value IE if provided.

entities.name: Lower bound timer value IE
entities.description: An optional IE provided by the network indicating the minimum timer value for entries in the list.

entities.name: Conditions for allowed access to listed PLMN
entities.description: Conditions under which the UE may attempt access to a PLMN in the list: current location known and distance exceeds threshold, timer expired, or access for emergency services.

entities.name: Conditions for entry removal
entities.description: Conditions under which an entry is removed: successful registration via satellite NG-RAN to the PLMN, timer expiration, or UE implementation decision based on distance.

entities.name: Access for emergency services
entities.description: Access to a PLMN in the list is allowed if for emergency services, regardless of other conditions.

relations.description: The list contains entries identified by PLMN identity.
Each entry in the list may include geographical location if known.
Each entry includes a UE implementation specific distance value if geographical location is stored.
Upon storing a new entry, the UE starts a timer instance associated with the entry.
The timer value shall not be smaller than the value indicated by the Lower bound timer value IE if provided.
Access to a PLMN in the list is allowed only if specific conditions are met.
Entries are removed from the list under specified conditions such as successful registration or timer expiration.
Access for emergency services is an allowed condition regardless of other restrictions.
